title: Silent Book Club
venue: Walker Memorial Library : Eleanor Conant Room
description: Enjoy quiet reading in our beautiful historic wing with other patrons. Be part of our silent book club with no commitments, no assigned reading, and no required discussion! Bring a book (or borrow one from us) and read whatever you would like while sitting in one of our cozy chairs in the Eleanor Conant Room. All ages that can read silently are welcome, but under age 8 must be with an adult.

title: Special City Council Meeting
description: Westbrook City Council meets in person at Westbrook High School in Room 114, with a remote participation option available via Zoom. In order to ensure inclusion of all written public comments into the meeting record, any submissions must be received by the City Clerk's Office no later than 10am the morning of each meeting.

title: Family Storytime at Walker Library
venue: Walker Memorial Library, Youth Services Program Room
description: Family Storytime at Walker Memorial Library is geared to ages 1-3 with caregivers, but all ages are welcome. We will sing, move around, read books, and have fun! Storytimes are Tuesdays and Thursdays at 10:30am in the Youth Services Program Room.

title: Baby Lapsit - Under age 2
description: Baby Lapsit is a gentle storytime for babies under age 2 and their caregivers. A gentle program of rhyming, reading, and playtime on Wednesdays from 10:30am-11 in our Youth Program Room.

title: Silly Science - Candy DNA

description: Silly science: Candy DNA! Learn a bit of DNA science and have a lot of fun with us! Make a DNA model out of candy! Geared to ages 5 - 10 but open to everyone.

title: Nature Storytime at Pride Preserve - Registration required
description: Join Walker Memorial Library and our friends at the Presumpscot Regional Land Trust for an outdoor storytime and hike at Pride Preserve in Westbrook. This free event is designed for families with children ages 2–5 (siblings welcome), accompanied by a parent or guardian over 18. Registration is required.

title: Portland Ballet presents: Dracula
description: Portland Ballet's ballet adaptation of Bram Stoker's Dracula, with choreography by Nell Shipman and a score by Rachmaninoff. Recommended for ages 11 and up due to mature themes. Info: 207-772-9671.

title: Drug Take Back Day
description: Drop off your unused or unwanted prescription medication at no cost and with no questions asked at the Westbrook Public Safety Building. Please bring no liquids or needles. A drop-off kiosk is also available in the lobby 24/7.

title: Adult/Teen Craft: Fall Luminaries (Ages 12+)
description: Make a luminary out of a mason jar, glass paint, and black vinyl! It could be a jack-o-lantern, a monster, a leaf, or whatever you can come up with. This craft will be upstairs in the historic wing for ages 12 and up.

title: Monsters Run the River: 5k, 5k Canine, 1K Fun Run
description:
Experience the exciting Monsters Run the River 5K, hosted by Discover Downtown Westbrook! This ninth-annual charming road race takes runners through downtown Westbrook and alongside the picturesque Presumpscot River, all set against stunning fall foliage and historic architecture.

See below for the race route, race formats, and how to register to Run the River! This year’s race features official timing, a local vendor market, music, and awards for costumes and racers! Join in the fun this October in downtown Westbrook.

Wear your best costume—and dress up your dog, too—for Discover Downtown Westbrook’s annual Halloween-themed road race. The event includes a traditional 5K, Canine 5K, children’s Fun Run, local vendors, music and costume awards.

Race-day schedule:

8 a.m.: Registration and bib pickup
8:30 a.m.: Children’s Fun Run 1K
8:45 a.m.: Canine 5K
9 a.m.: Main 5K
10 a.m.: Race and costume awards

Registration: https://raceroster.com/events/2026/139729/monsters-run-the-river

title: Turkey Trot 5K & Kids 1 Mile
description: This is a great fundraiser for our Project Graduation for the class of 2027. All proceeds will go directly to the class. Our Kids Mile - designed for participants age 12 and under, starting at 8:30am at the high school track. A traditional 5K will start at 9:30am in the parking lot by the baseball field. Runners and walkers are all welcome. All participants will receive a commemorative Turkey Trot 2026 medal! You'll need to pick up your bib and race prep items. We'll be hosting bib pickup Admission: $25 adults/ $10 kids 1 mile
